parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "qwen/qwen3.8-27b",
  "max_tokens": 2000,
  "response_format": { "type": "json_object" },
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are the Chief Solutions Architect and Commercial Proposal Director at OliveSoft, premier IT engineering firm in Tunisia. Given the tender context, buyer intelligence dossier, and OliveSoft RAG capability match, generate an executive commercial proposal. Return ONLY a JSON object with: executive_summary (string), client_challenges (array of strings), technical_solution (string), proposed_architecture (string), staffing_plan (array of objects with name, role, why_fit), pricing_estimate_tnd (number), timeline_weeks (number), slides (array of 6 objects with title and content)."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": {{ JSON.stringify('### TENDER SPECIFICATIONS:
ID: ' + ($json.tender_id || '') + '
Buyer: ' + ($json.buyer || '') + '
Country: ' + ($json.country || '') + '
Description: ' + ($json.description || '') + '

### BUYER INTELLIGENCE DOSSIER (FROM PROSPECT RESEARCH):
Sector: ' + ($json.prospect_profile.sector || '') + '
Budget: ' + ($json.prospect_profile.estimated_budget || '') + '
Org Size: ' + ($json.prospect_profile.org_size || '') + '
Contacts: ' + (($json.prospect_profile.key_contacts || []).join(', ')) + '
Past Projects: ' + (($json.prospect_profile.past_it_projects || []).join('; ')) + '
Summary: ' + ($json.prospect_profile.research_summary || '') + '

### OLIVESOFT CAPABILITIES & RAG MATCH:
Fit Score: ' + (($json.rag_matching.fit_score * 100).toFixed(1)) + '%
Staffing: ' + JSON.stringify($json.rag_matching.staffing_suggestions || []) + '
Coverage: ' + JSON.stringify($json.rag_matching.coverage_matrix || [])) }}
    }
  ]
}
